name: Winslow Homer
findings: Within his own canvases, light cinnamon turns up as a small accent in 75% of the paintings that hold it, 2.1x the archive's rate (from 699 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, smoke turns up as the lightest note in 60% of the paintings that hold it, 3.2x the archive's rate (from 699 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, mole brown turns up as the shadow in 69% of the paintings that hold it, 2.6x the archive's rate (from 699 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 699 paintings here).
Pairs burn blue with sky grey more than chance would predict (3 of 699 paintings here).
Pairs squirrel grey with steel grey more than chance would predict (3 of 699 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (greyish white, french grey, oatmeal) covers 70% of his paintings here.
Keeps 2 distinct palette families here, from greyish white, french grey to dark olive brown, bistre.
